title: console app bar: a host can ask for no app switcher when the viewer is served one app — the cloud control plane draws 「云 ▾」 with 「所有应用」 linking to the app the user is already in
body:
## Source

objectstack-ai/cloud#2919 (from the maintainer's 2026-10-16 walk of the cloud control plane): the control plane is one product, Cloud, with one companion, the user's account settings. Its top bar should draw no app switcher; the 预览版 chip stays beside the product mark. The cloud half is objectstack-ai/cloud PR #2980: the control plane's `account` app is now `hidden: true`, reached from the avatar menu's 「个人资料」. That leaves the switcher with one row, and the rest is this repository's: the console has no setting to draw no switcher.

## Measured (cloud's objectui pin `ef71a09f9e5f`, and `main` `97538115`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppSwitcher.tsx`:
  - It lists apps with `active !== false && hidden !== true` (pin :62, `main` :79).
  - It returns null only when no active app resolves (pin :66, `main` :83). So one listed app still draws the 「云 ▾」 pill and its dropdown.
- At `main`, the dropdown carries 「Back to home」, 「All apps」 (:134-156, objectui#12605) and a Settings row for viewers served Setup (:157-169). In the control plane, 「所有应用」 links to the declared home, `/apps/cloud_control`, which is the app the viewer is already in.
- `AppHeader.tsx` draws the pill whenever `activeAppName && onAppChange` (`main` :877-887). `runtime-config.ts:277-300` (`AppShellRuntimeConfig`) has no single-app or switcher field.
- What the control plane serves (`GET /api/v1/meta/app` after PR #2980):
  - owners, plain members and org-less signups are served one un-hidden app, `cloud_control`;
  - a platform admin is served two, `cloud_control` and `platform_admin` (Cloud Admin), and the switcher is that admin's door to Cloud Admin.

## Target

1. A host can ask the console to draw no app switcher, and so no pill dropdown and no 「所有应用」, when the viewer is served exactly one un-hidden active app. The app's name or the product mark stands in its place.
2. Scope: only where the host asks. objectui#12605's 「主页 / 所有应用 / 设置」 rows stay for every other deployment, tenant environments included.
3. A viewer served more than one un-hidden app (the control plane's platform admin) keeps the switcher.
4. The 预览版 chip stays beside the product mark when the pill goes.

## Suggested shape (this lane's call)

A field in `AppShellRuntimeConfig`, which the control plane serves from `packages/service-cloud/src/multi-environment-plugins.ts` (cloud), gating a derived rule: no switcher when one app is served.
- A flag alone would hide Cloud Admin's door from the platform admin.
- A derived rule alone would change the chrome for every single-app viewer in every deployment, and it would retire #12605's rows there unmeasured.
- The runtime config is host-produced, not authored metadata.

The cloud follow-up (serving the field, then the pin bump) is the cloud seat's once this lands.

## Acceptance

- Tests: with the host field set and one served app, no pill dropdown and no 「所有应用」. With two served apps, the switcher is drawn. Without the field, today's behaviour is unchanged.
- The cloud seat reads the control plane's top bar after cloud's pin carries this.

<sub>Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the os-dev report on cloud#2919 (PR #2980). ⛔ Not a claim. Dedupe: this repository's issues since 2026-08-15 by title and body (`app switcher`, `AppSwitcher`, `single-app`, `All apps`, `所有应用`): objectui#12605, #12461, #12201, #12625 (closed; the pill's design and names), none a single-app setting.</sub>
